newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Illinois rail basis offers up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Illinois rail basis offers up.

text.p: Offers for soymeal in Illinois rail markets were higher on increased demand from commercial firms, U.S. dealers said.
"Basis has roared back up," said a dealer in the southeast. Two crushers were said to be buying soymeal in those markets to cover orders for plants that will be taking downtime soon, brokers said.
Basis offers in other markets were mostly unchanged, but some dealers reported a firm undertone to the market.
"We're unchanged this morning (Friday), but the basis is definitely headed higher," an Illinois crusher said.

Some cited a drop in the weekly crush as one source for the market's strength. The National Oilseed Processor Association put the weekly crush at 25.6 million bushels, down from last week's pace of 26.2 million.
Trade sources had estimated the crush at 25.0 million to 25.95 million bushels.
